newsitem.title: USA: US tax bill to cut net $95 bln over 5 years - Archer.
newsitem.headline: US tax bill to cut net $95 bln over 5 years - Archer.

text.p: House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Bill Archer said Wednesday the latest estimate on the U.S. tax bill was that it would amount to about a $95 billion net tax cut over five years.

That would be slightly higher than the estimate Tuesday of a $94 billion tax cut, and $10 billion more than the $85 billion agreed to in the May budget agreement between congressional Republicans and the White House.
"The Joint Committee (on Taxation) has told me that the net tax cut will be $95 billion," the Texas Republican told a small group of reporters.
The House passed 346-85 companion spending legislation and Archer said: "I think the tax bill will pass overwhelmingly also."
In September, after the congressional recess, Archer said his committee will concentrate on fast-track trade legislation.
